prompts.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE production background plate for a vertical-scrolling anime fantasy danmaku game, first stage titled Star Corridor. Extremely tall portrait 1024 x 3072 pixels, 1:3 width-to-height. This is ONLY the background scenery, no characters, enemies, bullets, UI, words, frame, logo or watermark. Top-down aerial game view, viewed vertically down, not a horizon landscape. One continuous route from the BOTTOM cloud gateway, through the MIDDLE floating star-lit arcade, to the TOP celestial observatory. At the bottom, dark blue cloudbanks and two broken ivory gateway piers are mostly at the far left and far right edges. Through the middle, small floating architectural fragments, elegant blue-grey stone arcades, occasional dim ancient gold star lanterns remain on the extreme outer margins. At the top, an ancient circular astronomical observatory terrace with very subtle engraved concentric star charts, columns on far edges and a restrained dim gold star instrument centered near the top; the middle of the terrace is open. The entire central 65 percent of the image is spacious, very dark navy empty night sky, with sparse extremely dim tiny stars and soft blue atmospheric depth. No bright Milky Way, no large glowing stars in playable center, no diagonal beam crossing it. Consistent dark navy palette #090E1B #111E35, shaded silver-blue architecture #536580, very sparse desaturated antique gold #9C8555. Low contrast, quiet background intended to sit UNDER colorful moving bullets, no vivid pink/purple/orange. Beautiful detailed 2D anime game environment painting, softly simplified and clean at 480px width, gentle distant clouds, coherent materials, readable silhouettes. Upper and lower 640px game viewport must both be useful compositions and scrolling must reveal a continuous coherent place, no contact sheet, no separate panels, no decorative border. Keep any ring decoration dim, geometry calm, no full-screen white lighting. Deliver the single uninterrupted tall background artwork.

Use case: game-asset sprite sheet. Create ONE real transparent PNG sprite atlas for a small front-facing anime star fairy enemy in a vertical danmaku game. Output landscape 1536 x 1152, EXACT regular 4 columns by 3 rows of equal 384x384 cells, NO visible grid lines, NO text, NO labels, NO background, true transparent alpha. All 12 cells contain the same ONE fairy, perfectly consistent face, colors, scale and cell-centered registration. Draw genuine crisp low-resolution pixel art intended for a 48x48 native game sprite, enlarged nearest-neighbor for the atlas; limited palette with hard pixel clusters, no soft painted shading, no antialias blur, no glow, no ground shadow. Fairy is a petite chibi young woman with short ice-blue bob hair, small simple silver star hairpin, dark navy short dress with silver collar and hem, blue shoes, a pair of small white-blue feather wings stretching horizontally. Friendly serious anime face, seen from above and front toward the player below, face visible, no back view. Body is chunky and readable at tiny size: solid torso and wide skirt, body central mass about 18px wide; the wings are decorative and not a large halo. Entire figure fits inside 40x40 native pixel area in each 48x48 cell, no touching cell edges. All feet rest at same relative baseline, torso center at same relative cell point. ROW 1: four phases of gentle hovering wing flap facing front. ROW 2: four phases of same wing flap flying LEFT, subtle lean left with the same face and costume. ROW 3: four phases flying RIGHT, subtle lean right; hairpin stays on the SAME anatomical side, do not mirror it. Small natural variation only wing feathers, hem, bobbing by at most one native pixel; stable body and head proportions. Colors deep navy #1A2440, blue-grey #53639D, ice blue #8FBDE5, feather white #DCD9E7, silver #B9B8D2, light skin #FAD2BA; no golden long hair, no weapon, no circular magic effects. Prioritize precisely registered separate frames for actual game use. Every blank region including the cell gutters is fully transparent, never a checkerboard picture.

Use case: game-asset sprite sheet. Create ONE real transparent PNG sprite atlas for a front-facing anime celestial attendant enemy in a vertical danmaku game. Output landscape 1536 x 1152, EXACT regular 4 columns by 3 rows of equal 384x384 cells, NO visible grid lines, no words or labels, true transparent alpha. Same ONE character in all twelve cells, same scale and centered registration, body center stays fixed and feet same baseline. Genuine crisp limited-palette pixel art intended for 48x64 native sprite; large blocky nearest-neighbor pixel clusters, no smooth painted shading, antialiasing or glow. Petite chibi young woman with a muted lavender chin-length bob, straight bangs, tiny silver star clasp, slim long dark-indigo tunic and dress panels, narrow feather wings folded downward alongside her body, silver cuffs, pale skin and blue shoes. Distinct TALL NARROW silhouette, no big horizontal wings. Viewed from above and FRONT toward the player below, clear simple anime face, not back view. Short silver staff held vertically on her right side (viewer left), dim pale gold four-point star tip. The center torso and flared lower tunic are solid and at least 20 native pixels across around the waist for a clear physical core. Figure occupies about 34 pixels wide by 50 pixels tall within a 48x64 native cell; generous transparent gutters. ROW 1: four registered frames of hovering and very slight cloth motion, staff relaxed. ROW 2: four frames raising staff into a locked aiming charge, tip becomes modestly brighter but no free particles or beams. ROW 3: four firing/recovery frames with a short wrist motion and staff returning, no actual projectile drawn. Preserve identical hair, clothing and wing anatomy across frames; body centered, not moving around. Palette navy #1A2440, violet #6D648E #A49BC4, silver #DCD9E7, pale skin #FAD2BA, restrained gold #C3AC7F. Transparent background including gutters, no checkerboard drawing, no ground shadow, no outlines around cells.

Use case: game-asset sprite sheet. Create ONE real transparent PNG atlas of a celestial clockwork star guardian for a vertical danmaku game. Landscape 1536 x 1152, EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows equal square 384x384 cells, no visible grid, no labels/text, true transparent background. All 12 cells show the same top-down facing circular mechanical magical construct, no human face, no humanoid body. Genuine crisp limited-color pixel art for native 80x80 sprites, nearest-neighbor enlarged blocky pixel edges, no soft illustration blur, no glow or ground shadow. Wide round antique gold astronomical ring surrounds a LARGE SOLID circular faceted indigo-blue core disk, silver-blue engraved plates and four broad ivory-silver protective fins at north/east/south/west. Visible core itself is at least 44 native pixels in diameter and fully solid, ring diameter 60 native pixels, four fins make complete silhouette about 72x72 inside an 80x80 native cell. Tiny central pale silver eight-point star emblem integrated into core, modest highlights, no holes in central core, no thin invisible core, no bright white orb. Same centered position and fixed scale in every cell with generous transparent margins. ROW 1: 4 frames of slow outer ring rotation while main core and fins remain anchored. ROW 2: 4 charging frames: four ring segments light successively in muted gold, center stays readable. ROW 3: 4 firing/recovery frames: ring segments briefly brighter then return to idle, no actual bullets/beams/particles outside object. Palette deep navy #1A2440 #28345D, desaturated blue #53639D #8CAACB, antique gold #B98632 #D9C191, silver ivory #DCD9E7. Clear broad central danger silhouette and restrained details, strong small-scale readability. Blank pixels and all gutters are truly transparent, not a painted checkerboard.
